name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
summary: Stormwind's mages once guarded Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, fearing what its pages could bring. Now the tome lies hidden in the Tower of Ilgalar, stolen by Morganth.

sections.title: A Dangerous Legacy
sections.body: Ur of Dalaran wrote of shadow magic and its subtle, corruptive nature. The mages of Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum feared these arts could bring doom to the unwary, so they sealed the volume against readers. After Morganth gave himself to dark arts and Stormwind's magical circle exiled him, he carried the tome east into the Redridge Mountains. There he made his stronghold in the Tower of Ilgalar.

sections.title: The Warded Secrets
sections.body: High Sorcerer Andromath feared Morganth might master the dark lore in Ur's work. He sent adventurers into the Tower of Ilgalar to reclaim it. Morganth had sunk deep into forbidden magic, yet the warding seals placed by Stormwind's circle held firm. The book remained unopened until it was recovered.

faq.answer: Ur was a respected wizard and scholar from Dalaran. He studied extraplanar creatures, dark arts, and esoteric magic, including shadow craft.

faq.q: Why is the treatise so dangerous?
faq.answer: Shadow magic can corrupt an untrained practitioner and bring doom and ruin. High Sorcerer Andromath warns against probing its forbidden depths.

faq.q: Who stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic?
faq.answer: Morganth stole the tome after Stormwind's wizard order banished him for succumbing to dark magic. He fled east to the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

faq.q: Did Morganth manage to read the treatise?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind's mages sealed the tome, and their wards held fast. Morganth could not open it before its recovery.

faq.q: Is this the same work as The Book of Ur?
aliases: is this the book of ur
faq.answer: Both works are by Ur and closely related. The Book of Ur is a broader grimoire kept in the ruins of Shadowfang Keep. The Treatise on Shadow Magic appears to be an excerpt or a specialized volume focused on shadow arts.

angles.text: As a mage of Stormwind, you help contain the treatise and preserve the Sanctum's safety after one of its own succumbed to dark temptations.
As an Alliance traveler, you know Morganth's presence in Redridge threatens the kingdom's eastern frontier. Retrieving the powerful artifact matters to Stormwind's security.
